description: The chart titled “Recall@10” presents an ablation-style comparison of Recall@10 values across four methods. The category axis is horizontal and lists the methods in left-to-right order as “Ours,” “- critiquing,” “- scoring,” and “- ranking,” with labels shown at an angle; no explicit x-axis label is shown. The value axis is vertical with a linear scale labeled implicitly by the title metric, spanning from 0.1 to 0.4, with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.1 intervals (0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4). There are four single (non-stacked, non-grouped) bars: “Ours” is colored orange and reaches approximately 0.35; “- critiquing” is colored blue and reaches about 0.29; “- scoring” is blue and reaches about 0.17; and “- ranking” is blue and reaches about 0.23–0.24. The bars are not shown as sorted by value (they follow the displayed method order), and the only visual emphasis is the distinct orange color used for “Ours” while the remaining methods share the same blue color; no annotations, outlines, or legend are present.
caption_used: Ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset. The bar chart illustrates Recall@10 values for four methods: 'Ours', '-critiquing', '-scoring', and '-ranking'. 'Ours' achieves the highest Recall@10 value, approximately 0.35, while '-scoring' exhibits the lowest performance at roughly 0.12. Notably, '-ranking' consistently outperforms '-critiquing' with a Recall@10 value of approximately 0.28 compared to '-critiquing's 0.25. The chart highlights a steady decline in performance from 'Ours' to '-scoring', with '-ranking' showing a slight recovery in Recall@10 values. The vertical axis ranges from 0.1 to 0.4, and the bars are color-coded, with 'Ours' in orange and the other methods in blue.
